description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

John Deere is hiring a Software Engineer for Deere & Company Computer Center in Moline, Illinois. The role monitors and supports edge network services, responds to incidents, builds monitoring and automation, troubleshoots connectivity, and supports network rollouts and maintenance.
Software Engineer supporting edge network services through monitoring, incident response, Python automation, and site connectivity troubleshooting

Responsibilities:
• Monitor the health of edge network services (LAN, WiFi, SD-WAN and cellular) and respond to alerts, following runbooks and escalating when needed
• Participate in incident response and join the on-call rotation with support from senior engineers, and help write blameless postmortems and follow-up actions
• Build and maintain dashboards and alerts that give the team clear visibility into site and service health
• Write and maintain Python scripts and automation for routine tasks such as configuration backups, compliance checks and inventory reconciliation
• Troubleshoot connectivity issues at sites by gathering data, isolating the cause and documenting the fix
• Support site rollouts, SD-WAN cutovers and the Extreme Networks hardware refresh by executing planned changes, running pre-checks and validating results
• Keep documentation, network diagrams and runbooks accurate and current
• Handle network tickets and work with regional IT teams, vendors and carriers to resolve issues across time zones
• Contribute ideas and scripts that reduce repetitive manual work for the team

Requirements:
• Networking skills
• Solid foundation in TCP/IP and subnetting, plus routing and switching basics such as VLANs and BGP/OSPF concepts
• Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP and wireless networking basics
• Ability to troubleshoot connectivity problems methodically using tools such as ping, traceroute and Wireshark
• Exposure to enterprise network equipment (for example Extreme Networks or Cisco) through work, labs or coursework
• Observability skills
• Familiarity with monitoring concepts, including metrics, logs, alerts, SNMP and syslog
• Exposure to monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk or similar
• Some coding experience with Python or another scripting language. You are not expected to be a software developer; scripts from coursework, labs or personal projects count
• Basic familiarity with Git for version control
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, networking or engineering, or equivalent experience
• VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position
• Must be 18 years of age or older to apply

Preferred:
• Comfort working with APIs and JSON/YAML data is a plus
• 2 or more years of experience in networking, IT operations or a related field (internships, co-ops, labs and personal projects count)
• 2 or more years of experience in software engineering
